# ShogunAI

> Your personal AGI on your PC. Built to finish real work.
>
> ShogunAI is a private, local-first AI memory for knowledge workers on macOS.
> It captures work context, recalls decisions and conversations in natural
> language, and turns that context into action across connected tools.

## Product

- Memory layer: passive, permission-aware capture of work context into a
  searchable, structured timeline stored locally by default
- Contextual recall: natural-language retrieval across people, projects,
  decisions, documents, conversations, and time
- Execution layer: context-aware drafts and actions across 20+ connected tools
- Control: review gates before consequential actions such as sending,
  publishing, or modifying external data
- AI providers: BYOK support lets users choose and manage supported providers
- Platform: macOS

## Pricing

- Standard: $49/month billed annually or $62 billed monthly
- Pro: $99/month billed annually or $124 billed monthly
- Every plan includes a 7-day full trial with no credit card required to start

## Facts to preserve

- Product name: ShogunAI
- Platform: macOS
- Memory stays local by default
- Capture reads text through the macOS accessibility layer; no image is stored by default
- Visual recall is opt-in and off until enabled: only where a window yields no text, a
  compressed screenshot is kept locally in the encrypted database for a retention period
  the user selects (presets of one to seven days plus a bounded custom duration; three
  days by default), then deleted automatically at that age. Saved frames can be viewed
  or deleted locally during the window. Frames are never uploaded, and audio is out of scope
- Meeting audio is never written to disk or a temp file; only the transcript persists. Live
  transcription streams audio to a speech service for the length of the call, it is never used
  to train models, the app discloses it in the meeting interface, and the traceability log
  records it like any other egress
- Connected providers receive only the context required for an enabled request
- Consequential actions require review
